title: Deep Generative Models for Phylogenetic Inference with Complex Evolutionary Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.19053v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inference of phylogenetic trees from sequences plays a central role in understanding evolutionary relationships, with applications ranging from tracking pathogen spread to reconstructing the history of life. Conventionally, practitioners obtain posteriors over trees using likelihood-based methods like MCMC. However, likelihoods are only available for simple evolutionary models with restrictive assumptions. For realistic evolutionary models, inference using conventional methods is prohibitively expensive, inaccurate, or even impossible. In practice, practitioners settle for using as flexible a conventional method as possible, even though they expect it is misspecified. In principle, we could use simulation-based inference: simulate tree and sequence data from an evolutionary model and train a neural network to predict the posterior over trees given sequences. However it is a mathematical challenge to represent and train complex posterior

translated_title: 面向复杂进化过程的系统发育推断深度生成模型
translated_abstract: 从序列数据推断系统发育树在理解进化关系中发挥着核心作用，其应用范围涵盖从追踪病原体传播到重建生命演化历史。传统上，研究者使用基于似然的方法（如MCMC）来获得树的后验分布。然而，似然函数仅适用于具有严格假设的简单进化模型。对于更贴近现实的进化模型，使用传统方法进行推断的代价极其高昂、不准确，甚至根本无法实现。在实践中，研究者只能退而求其次，尽可能使用足够灵活的传统方法，即使他们预期该方法存在模型误设。原则上，我们可以采用基于模拟的推断方法：从进化模型中模拟生成树和序列数据，然后训练神经网络在给定序列的条件下预测树的后验分布。然而，如何表示和训练复杂的后验分布是一个数学上的挑战……
tldr: 提出利用深度生成模型进行基于模拟的系统发育推断，以突破传统似然方法在处理复杂进化过程时无法准确高效推断树后验分布的局限。
en_tdlr: Proposes using deep generative models for simulation-based phylogenetic inference to overcome the limitations of likelihood-based methods, which cannot accurately or efficiently infer tree posteriors under complex evolutionary processes.
